quote: The art of debugging is figuring out what you really told your program to do.
author: Andrew Singer

quote: The biggest issue you'll face in security, and in life, is your own stupidity.
author: Jonathan Walpole

quote: The best programs are written so that computing machines can perform them quickly and so that human beings can understand them clearly. A programmer is ideally an essayist who works with traditional aesthetic and literary forms as well as mathematical concepts, to communicate the way that an algorithm works and to convince a reader that the results will be correct.
author: Donald E. Knuth

quote: ...if you aren't, at any given time, scandalized by code you wrote five or even three years ago, you're not learning anywhere near enough
author: Nick Black

quote: You are not reading this book because a teacher assigned it to you, you are reading it because you have a desire to learn, and wanting to learn is the biggest advantage you can have.
author: Cory Althoff

quote: The greatest enemy of knowledge is not ignorance, it is the illusion of knowledge.
author: Steven Hawking

quote: The only way to learn a new programming language is by writing programs in it.
author: Dennis Ritchie

quote: Measuring programming progress by lines of code is like measuring aircraft building progress by weight.
author: Bill Gates

quote: Your life is not about getting some f***ing task done, it is about building a YOU.
author: Hank Green

quote: I cannot remember the books I've read any more than the meals I have eaten; even so, they have made me.
author: Ralph Waldo Emerson

quote: Sucking at something is the first step towards being kinda good at something.
author: Jake the Dog

quote: Education is about making your head an interesting place to spend the rest of your life.
author: unknown

quote: Given the opportunity, players will optimize the fun out of a game.
author: Soren Johnson

quote: One day, every major city in America will have a telephone.
author: Alexander Graham Bell - Inventor of the Telephone (*1847)
